purpose: The refusal-coverage floor the S4 re-pins must not fall below. Derived from the real src/lib/codegen.server.test.ts and src/lib/synthesis-policy.test.ts bytes: the pre-S4 HEAD suite carried 52 `p6.synthesis.refused` (annotation: HEAD) and 56 coded-reason assertions; S4's honest re-pins raised the refused count to 54 while moving the legacy single-sample pins to explicit opt-out variants. A re-pin that DELETES or WEAKENS a refusal (instead of moving it to an opt-out variant) drops a count below these floors and fires RT_E_REFUSAL_COVERAGE_LOST.
